title: UI seeks approval for Developmental Studies Hybridoma Bank facility improvements
summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking approval from the Iowa Board of Regents at its November meeting to renovate the Biology Building's north wing, creating a dedicated space for its internationally recognized Developmental Studies Hybridoma Bank (DSHB).
title_cn: UI seeks approval for Developmental Studies Hybridoma Bank facility improvements

title: UI seeks approval for IMU footbridge renovations
summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking approval from the Iowa Board of Regents at its November meeting to renovate the Iowa Memorial Union (IMU) footbridge, replacing aging decking and railings and making other improvements to extend the bridge's life.
title_cn: UI seeks approval for IMU footbridge renovations
